Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.ui

Class TitleScreen

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.ui.TitleScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
Screen
public class TitleScreen extends Object implements Screen
The opening screen: the story of the Halls, the adventurer's name, difficulty, and the main menu (new game, Orientation tutorial, continue, high scores, quit).

      Parameters:
